The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information, including the proper procedures for conducting background checks for employment purposes. By adhering to the standards specified by the FCRA, the bank is ensuring compliance with federal regulations.
